Values._comment_storage: Identity-based AzureWebJobsStorage (no connection string / account key). The Functions runtime AND the app-level BlobServiceClient/QueueServiceClient authenticate via DefaultAzureCredential against these URIs. The signed-in identity needs Storage Blob Data Contributor + Storage Queue Data Contributor on the account. In Azure, set AzureWebJobsStorage__credential=managedidentity (and __clientId for a user-assigned MI). Copy this file to local.settings.json and fill in real values — local.settings.json is gitignored.
